prompt: $1,000 is invested at 12% per annum, compounded quarterly. What is the value of the investment after one year, in dollars?
trap_note: Quarterly compounding divides the rate and raises the power: 1000 x (1 + 0.12/4)^4 = 1125.51. Applying the annual rate once gives 1000 x 1.12 = 1120, which ignores the compounding the question names explicitly while still producing a defensible-looking figure.
